name: school_exterior
description: The outdoor area of a small Greek village school with a playground and garden.

color_palette: Mediterranean Blue (#007BA7) for painted wood accents and trim
Sunset Orange (#FF4500) for roof tiles and decorative elements
Olive Green (#808000) for garden plants and climbing vines
visual_style.architectural_style: Simple traditional Greek village school building with white-washed walls and wooden accents. Features a covered porch area with wooden columns and colorful painted details. Small windows with wooden shutters and a gently sloped roof with terracotta tiles.
visual_style.flora_fauna: Olive trees, bougainvillea climbing on trellises, and small flowering herbs like rosemary and thyme dot the garden area. Small birds flutter around the eaves, and butterflies visit the colorful flowers. A small stone bird bath sits near the entrance.
materials: White-washed stucco walls with painted blue wooden trim
Terracotta roof tiles in burnt orange and red tones
Natural stone foundation and pathway stones
Wooden porch columns and playground equipment
